state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place) is under way.** Stage 3 is done: `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md` names every goal in front of `goal-closeout`.

A served request's `Core\Config::set("cpu_time", …)` now moves the ceiling its tree is charged against. `nvs_host::Isolate::start` calls `Ctx::take_tree_cpu_limit` on a watched isolate (`Charge::Tree` only), which takes the connection's ceiling and reserve and makes the isolate the context that publishes into `TreeState::cpu_limit`. A `spawn script` child is never watched and still moves only its own number. The test `a_watched_isolate_states_its_trees_cpu_ceiling_and_an_unwatched_one_does_not` in `crates/nvs-host/src/isolate.rs` pins both halves. Gap `a-cpu-time-set-at-run-time-is-not-enforced` is deleted.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is many commits ahead of `origin/main`, and the loop never pushes (module doc of `tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts`). A person has to push, so no session can close it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` still names many gaps: `nvs-host` (2), `nvs-lsp` (5), `nvs-runtime` and `nvs-stdlib` the largest, plus `nvs-types`, `editors/vscode` and `website`. Stage 4 stops on `BLOCKED` only for "too large", as the goal's § *Stage 4* defines it.
